rules.coordinates: OperationalPlan/action JSON tile is [row,col]. Runtime tile is (x=col,y=row), converted as (col,row).
rules.damage: Current formula layer: physical max(0.05A,A-D); arts max(0.05A,0.01A*(100-RES)); attack interval T0/(clamp(S,10,600)/100).
rules.economy: Natural DP and provided ledger deltas are model calculations. Refunds, skill DP and merchant upkeep are only valid with their stated evidence and conditions.
rules.range_orientation: GameData range offsets are stored for RIGHT. ApproximateRealRangeTransformer rotates them in bottom-left field coordinates.
rules.simulator_win: Current Simulator wins when no enemy leaks, the spawn schedule is exhausted, and no active enemies remain.
rules.time_sp_recovery: Current public low-rarity runtime advances time-SP by 1.0 SP/s only while inactive. SP is paused while a skill is active.
rules.unknown: Exact client timing, active roadblock ordinary-WALK navigation, target priority and unsupported effects remain UNKNOWN unless supplied evidence says otherwise.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Move central blockers to column 5, place the temporary caster at [5,5], and deploy Hibiscus immediately after Vanilla's first supported DP activation.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: The original left caster and pioneers could survive until the scheduled healing and upgrades.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Use early healing and scheduled defensive replacements; explicitly retain opening survival as a verification dependency.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: Temporary outer units could be left on their original upgrade deadlines.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Every later deployment depends on the revised pioneers surviving to their credited activations; no retreat refunds fund this plan.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: A ledger remains valid after its DP-producing operators die.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Use later right-facing casters against the right-side waits and explicitly require verification of the remaining patrol HP budget.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: Left-side caster coverage alone establishes a patrol kill.

corridor_responsibilities.attack: Opening Gallus; later Steward plus the blocker.
Opening Gallus; later Lava and Midnight's supported skill.
Blocker's ordinary physical attacks; no final caster coverage credited.
corridor_responsibilities.healing: Hibiscus, including the first healing skill at 55 seconds.

corridor_responsibilities.attack: Blocker's ordinary physical attacks; no unsupported self-heal or defensive talent credited.
Lava covers [5,7]; Steward covers [2,7]. Use their supported attacks and skills during overlap.
corridor_responsibilities.limitation: No blocking credit; sufficient cumulative damage before the patrol exits is UNKNOWN.
corridor_responsibilities.survival: Medics cover both final casters. Do not assume a defender redirects patrol attacks.

corridor_responsibilities.limitation: Friendly targeting, blocking and device navigation remain UNKNOWN.
corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Preserve civilian passage and monitor survival; do not deliberately attack or obstruct civilians.

explicit_deadline_basis.opening: Column-5 central runner interception is approximately 13.35/18.35 seconds. Column-3 outer interception is approximately 29.53/34.53 seconds.

explicit_deadline_basis.condition: Both pioneers survive and listed DP skills execute. Values exclude retreat refunds and any DP-cap benefit.
explicit_deadline_basis.economy: Opening uses effective Fang cost 10, natural DP, Fang's automatic +6 DP and Vanilla's supported immediate +6 DP. No refunds or robot DP talents are credited.

explicit_deadline_basis.timing: Action frames are chosen under the supplied 30 FPS model, not asserted client timings.

formation_structure.final: Beagle and Cardigan hold outer lanes; Melantha and Midnight hold central lanes. Steward and Lava cover their corresponding central blockers and right-side patrol waits.
formation_structure.fire_sharing_limit: Final casters do not cover the outer blocking tiles. Outer defenders must clear their own queues while receiving healing.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla hold central routes; downward-facing Gallus covers both blocking tiles. CONFESS-47 and Friston-3 hold outer routes farther left.

formation_transitions.consequence: Central pioneers temporarily lose shared Arts support; both medics must sustain them.
formation_transitions.handoff: Retreat Gallus before the patrol approaches its lower firing position.
Deploy Lava on Gallus's vacated tile, facing RIGHT.
formation_transitions.purpose: Restore lower central Arts damage and cover the right lower patrol wait.

formation_transitions.constraint: Retreat precedes deployment by one frame. Brief enemy release and reacquisition are current-model verification dependencies.
formation_transitions.handoff: Replace CONFESS-47 with Beagle, then Friston-3 with Cardigan.
Deploy Steward into the eighth slot.
formation_transitions.purpose: Add upper central Arts damage and right upper patrol coverage.

formation_transitions.constraint: Do not credit DP activations after either pioneer's retreat.
formation_transitions.handoff: Replace Vanilla with Midnight, then Fang with Melantha.
formation_transitions.purpose: Improve sustained central damage before final armored and runner pressure.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: Never deploy on the four forbidden device tiles; never exceed eight deployed operators.
Keep separate blockers for all four ground corridors. A replacement retreats its predecessor first.
Do not assume target redirection, unsupported robot effects, Cardigan self-healing, probabilistic talents or AoE geometry.
Keep both medics deployed through final clearance; verify healing competition rather than treating nominal coverage as sufficient healing.
If a prerequisite operator dies or a deployment is unaffordable, classify the fixed candidate as failed; do not silently credit subsequent skills or invent replacement actions.
Device destruction does not establish a navigation effect.
Declare WIN only with zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Keep the central pioneers outside the initial left patrol exposure, establish both outer holds, and deliver healing before temporary blockers fail. Gallus supports both central lanes until its retreat.
Complete durable outer replacements and the upper caster. Clear officer queues without releasing outer lanes; transition central pioneers only after replacement DP exists.
Use supported Arts attacks against armored central enemies while both medics remain deployed.
Reserve Midnight's skill for 190-230 seconds, covering late runner pairs and armored follow-up. Use Melantha's attack skill and Beagle's defense skill at their listed windows.
Maintain all four holds, both medics and both casters through cleanup. Repeat ready skills only while their combat role remains necessary; finish only at WIN.

Immediate +6 DP and +35% ATK for 10 seconds; 30-second cycle includes paused SP recovery.

skill_intents.continuation: Every 50 seconds while healing remains necessary.
Every 60 seconds while healing remains necessary.
skill_intents.effect: Supported +40% healing ATK for 25 seconds; base range already covers assigned units.
Deployment +30 SP; supported +50 attack speed for 20 seconds. No splash geometry credited.
Supported attack-SP scaled-hit pattern; no highest-DEF targeting talent credited.

skill_intents.continuation: Next activation no earlier than 300 seconds if still needed.
skill_intents.effect: Supported Arts conversion and +35% ATK for 40 seconds.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Hold central routes at column 5 with temporary shared Arts support, hold outer routes at column 3 under paired medics, and transition to durable outer defenders plus stronger central attackers. Assign two later casters to the patrol's right-side waits without assuming target priority or lethal damage.

unknown_dependencies.dependency: CONFESS-47 survives until Hibiscus's first skill despite competing upper healing demands.
Ansel survives deployment near the departing lower patrol and delivers timely healing to Friston-3.
Central pioneers survive the interval between Gallus's retreat and Lava's deployment.
Final casters survive patrol exposure and accumulate 13000 effective damage before its exit; this budget is not established.
Outer queues remain within block capacity despite slow physical clearance and absent caster coverage.
Client civilian and roadblock interactions agree sufficiently with the partial runtime.

evidence_classes.CURRENT_MODEL: Deployment affordability, range rotation, SP recovery, combat targeting and diagnostic spawn times.
evidence_classes.GameData: Operator configurations, terrain, routes, enemy attributes and civilian death penalty.
evidence_classes.UNKNOWN: Client navigation around devices, client target ordering, civilian interactions and successful full-stage clearance.

revised_stage_understanding.revision_conclusion: Opening survival takes priority over the previous upgrade schedule. The revised formation moves central interception away from the initial patrol, supplies early shared fire, and advances healing. Patrol lethality remains an explicit unresolved dependency.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.qualification: This is a tactical candidate, not a demonstrated WIN. The patrol damage budget and opening healing competition require verification.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.thesis: Separate early central survival from later patrol damage: use a temporary caster across both central lanes, establish paired healing, then replace fragile outer blockers and strengthen central damage.

revised_tactical_requirements.configuration: Use supplied debug configurations; credit only supported mechanics.
revised_tactical_requirements.legal_catalog: Only supplied normal_low_star_catalog entries with identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode=true; exclude mode-specific reserves.

revision_source.revision_policy: GPT decides tactical changes; deterministic checks may only reject the original fixed actions
